# Destack

> Destack is a universal software engine: one language, one toolchain, and one runtime for libraries, services, and apps, compiled to native and the web from a single tree.
> The language is strict TypeScript++ - TypeScript-shaped source with value types, nominality, and checked arithmetic.
> Verification ships as toolchain verbs: destack test, bench, fuzz, and simulate (deterministic fault injection, replayable by seed).
> Host capability access is deny-by-default and granted per module in source.

## Site

- Home and fiddle (browsable demo workspace): https://destack.sh/
- Blog: https://destack.sh/blog/
- Introducing Destack: https://destack.sh/blog/introducing-destack/

## Source

- GitHub: https://github.com/destack-sh/destack
